newsitem.title: PERU: Lima bourse close mixed from profit-taking session.
newsitem.headline: Lima bourse close mixed from profit-taking session.

text.p: The Lima Stock Exchange closed mixed Friday as investors took profits from recent bull runs, but a majority of blue-chips ended in positive territory with miner Morococha extending its climb.
One trader said he expected investors to continue cashing in on stocks next week which had seen strong gains spurred on by higher-than-expected first quarter results.

The blue-chip index .ISEL closed down 0.06 percent at 2,707.28 points, while the general index .IGRAu ended down 0.23 percent to 1,847.21 points, according to preliminary figures at the market's 1330 local time (1830 GMT) close.
Miner Morococha closed up a healthy 4.51 percent at 5.10 soles, with strong 1.02 million share volume.
"Some investors defended the stock, putting the break on a major correction and giving it a larger closing volume," said trader Eder Egusquiza at brokerage Finanval.
The stock has recently seen strong gains backed up by investor enthusiasm after news that U.S. Phelps Dodge's announced it had bought a 27 percent stake in the company.
Blue-chip benchmark Telefonica del Peru also saw heavy trading, but suffered profit-taking to close down 1.85 percent at 6.36 soles, with over one million shares traded.
Elsewhere, mining company Atacocha suffered from investors taking profits, with the share ending down 0.59 percent at 1.69 soles with 963,065 shares traded.
Electric utility company Luz del Sur closed up 1.01 percent at 3.00 soles, with a modest 604,435 volume of shares traded.
